answer: The primary cellular mechanism enriched with gseapy/Reactome_2022 (top Reactome_2022 term by BH-adjusted p among DEGs, p<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5, baseMean>10) could NOT be determined in this environment: the Reactome_2022 gene-set library is not present locally and there is no network connectivity to download it (Enrichr Vía A failed with DNS resolution error; no local .gmt anywhere in the filesystem; Vía B and Vía C exhausted). No Reactome term is asserted because none can be verified. What was fully executed: DESeq2-equivalent differential expression for the CBD/cisplatin combination (group 9) vs Untreated (group 1) on the 10-group/30-sample design, yielding 2,222 DEGs (1,344 up / 878 down; baseMean>10, raw p<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5). The gseapy-equivalent over-representation pipeline (one-sided hypergeometric, Fisher odds ratio, BH adjustment, Enrichr combined score) is implemented in analysis.py and validated; it will report the primary term and its metrics (k/K, p, adjusted p, odds ratio, combined score, contributing genes) as soon as the Enrichr Reactome_2022 text library is provided at data/Reactome_2022.gmt (Vía B) or the script runs on a network-enabled runner (Vía A: https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=Reactome_2022).
